evidence.claim: The companion records a real LoRA training, adapter inference, checkpoint, and scale-sweep path.

corpus_audit.boundary: The historical run did not preserve a strict grouped corpus-audit artifact.

evidence.claim: A real FEMALE_01 LoRA run completed and wrote epoch checkpoints.

training.boundary: One historical run does not establish convergence across datasets or current upstream revisions.

evidence.claim: The training path preserved adapter checkpoints by epoch.

checkpoint_save.boundary: Saved checkpoints still require immutable package provenance.

evidence.claim: The selected adapter reloaded with explicit scale control.

fresh_process_reload.boundary: The recorded reload does not establish alternative-runtime compatibility.

evidence.claim: The epoch-10 adapter generated all 21 frozen runtime rows.

held_out_inference.boundary: Valid audio does not establish identity, accent, cadence, or naturalness.

evidence.claim: Runtime coverage and bounded objective checks were recorded.
The runner exposes a fail-closed upstream Base voice-clone control separately from adapter and full-SFT generation.
One Base ICL versus epoch-10 LoRA long-form pair completed all required objective metrics, non-directional prosody comparison, and focused blind-pack generation.

evaluation.boundary: The matched Base ICL comparison covers one prompt, seed, and reference. The conditioning APIs differ, and no blind ratings, multi-reference matrix, or quality winner is recorded.

evidence.claim: The LoRA lifecycle publishes a mode-bound content-addressed package through a path, device, and inode-bound external retention contract.

packaging.boundary: Dependency-free tests establish retention mechanics only. A real package, backup, restore, rights review, matched comparison, and listening evidence remain absent.

evidence.claim: The companion declares a distinct single-process full-SFT trainer, full-model reload path, frozen-plan evaluation, and research packaging lifecycle.
Preflight binds grouped train, validation, and test audit to dataset lineage.

corpus_audit.boundary: The wrapper tests are dependency-free and do not constitute a real corpus audit.

evidence.claim: The trainer applies the known text-projection and label-alignment fixes to full-weight optimization.
A clean RTX 3090 Ti run completed one finite full-SFT step and one finite resumed step with per-epoch validation and peak-memory evidence.

training.boundary: The run used one training row and one validation row for two optimization steps. It does not establish convergence, full-corpus behavior, quality, or multi-process training.

evidence.claim: The trainer writes a reloadable inference checkpoint plus a content-verified Accelerate state for trusted same-contract epoch-boundary resume.
The first checkpoint resumed from content-verified optimizer and RNG state, and the resumed checkpoint preserved a loadable custom-voice config plus its speech tokenizer.

checkpoint_save.boundary: Only a same-host, same-version, single-process epoch-boundary resume was tested. Mid-epoch, cross-version, distributed, and untrusted resume remain unsupported.

evidence.claim: The lifecycle extracts the selected full model and reloads it in a separate process.
A separate CUDA process loaded the resumed checkpoint and generated a valid 24 kHz WAV.

fresh_process_reload.boundary: The custom-voice reload intentionally ignores the unchanged speaker encoder used only to derive the registered speaker row. Alternative versions and runtimes remain untested.

evidence.claim: The resumed checkpoint generated all ten frozen text rows across four categories and three seeds.

held_out_inference.boundary: The matrix tests unseen generation text, not a full held-out corpus loss pass, and the checkpoint had only two optimization steps.

evidence.claim: The frozen-plan runner accepts either a LoRA adapter or a full-model checkpoint without loading both.
All ten rows received content-bound runtime, audio, prosody, ASR, and speaker evidence with complete required metric coverage.

evaluation.boundary: Two names-and-numbers rows failed the content gate, the reference transcript was ASR-derived, and no blind human ratings exist.

evidence.claim: The lifecycle binds the full model and evidence into a research package and publishes it through a mode-bound content-addressed external retention contract.

packaging.boundary: Dependency-free tests establish retention mechanics only. No real package, backup, restore, rights approval, or perceptual result exists.

evidence.claim: The upstream Base ICL voice-clone path generated the frozen long-form row in a clean fresh process.

runtimes.notes: One clean-checkout GPU long-form prompt passed. Instruction-bearing rows fail closed because the Base voice-clone API does not implement CustomVoice instructions.

evidence.claim: The epoch-10 LoRA CustomVoice path generated the matched long-form row in a clean fresh process.

runtimes.notes: A separate historical seven-prompt by three-seed LoRA suite also completed from a non-clean host checkout.

evidence.claim: A full-model PyTorch lifecycle is declared separately from the validated LoRA runtime.
One clean single-GPU bounded train, resume, reload, and ten-row objective evaluation completed on the 0.6B Base checkpoint.

runtimes.notes: Single-process only. The smoke establishes bounded compatibility, not convergence, perceptual quality, full lifecycle packaging, or production readiness.
No HTTP serving implementation is maintained in this focused companion.

blockers: Only one prompt, seed, reference, and LoRA checkpoint have a clean matched comparison, and the Base and LoRA conditioning APIs differ.

rights.code: The companion code is Apache-2.0; see LICENSE. Upstream code and weights remain separate rights surfaces.
rights.weights: Pin and review the upstream model-weight terms separately from this repository's code license.
rights.dataset: Record dataset provenance, permitted use, and speaker consent before training.
rights.generated_output: Review the model and dataset terms for the intended generated-output use.

known_gaps: Revalidate the patch against current official Qwen3-TTS fine-tuning before claiming incremental necessity.
The full-SFT path has one bounded two-step GPU train and resume, fresh reload, and ten-row generation smoke; full-corpus training, convergence, and quality remain unrecorded.
Full SFT intentionally rejects multi-process execution until distributed checkpoint semantics are reproduced.
Full SFT epoch-boundary resume has one same-host, same-version interrupted GPU continuation; mid-epoch, distributed, and cross-version resume remain unsupported.
Run real LoRA and full-SFT lifecycle packages through managed backup and verified restore after completing model, dataset, speaker, and generated-output rights review.
No alternative runtime has passed adapter-aware conformance.
The Base ICL versus epoch-10 comparison covers one long-form prompt, seed, and reference; multi-reference, multi-seed, and human ratings remain incomplete.
